posts.title: Grafana Begins Its Biggest UI Refresh Since Version 7
posts.description: Grafana Labs has introduced the first phase of its biggest visual refresh since Grafana 7, bringing updated themes, more consistent interface components, and improved visual hierarchy to its observability platform. By Craig Risi

posts.title: Presentation: From Fan-Out to Fast: Sub-100ms API Design in Distributed Systems
posts.description: Saranya Vedagiri explains how to design resilient, low-latency distributed APIs under 100ms. Drawing on practical scale at eBay, she discusses hop-by-hop latency budgets, async fanout tradeoffs, thread pool sizing, caching, and circuit breakers. Learn actionable strategies to eliminate tail-latency bottlenecks and establish performance-first engineering practices. By Saranya Vedagiri

posts.title: Article: Engineering Reliable Telematics from Smartphone Sensors
posts.description: Smartphones make telematics more accessible by combining location, motion sensors, computing power, and connectivity in a single device. But the convenience comes with a trade-off: device placement varies, sampling behavior is managed by the mobile platform, and measurements have different timing and coordinate semantics. This article explores a six-stage architecture to address these challenges.
